nodes.label: Design System (Tokens + Templates)
nodes.rationale: Token-first and template-first: never hard-code colours/sizes/radii/shadows/transitions; every visual value references a --token from design-tokens.css; styles.css holds only layout/position/unique overrides; visually-identical JS/legacy classes are aliased onto existing template selectors rather than duplicated.

nodes.label: Code Quality Standards
nodes.rationale: JSDoc on all exports, no magic numbers (UPPER_SNAKE_CASE constants), _-prefix private module state, no console.log in production, <=100-line functions, ordered imports, custom event names centralised in src/events.js, consistent try/catch in Cloudflare functions, and no dead code. The Architect enforces on new code; the Refactorer brings existing code up to them.

nodes.label: Preference Log (cross-session memory)
nodes.rationale: docs/PREFERENCE_LOG.md is read at session start and appended at session end/before deploy to persist decisions, preferences, patterns-to-follow/avoid, and session notes so settled questions are never re-asked.

nodes.label: Security Posture
nodes.rationale: Full CSP/HSTS/X-Frame-Options/Permissions-Policy in _headers; CORS locked to maps.karamahcollective.com; SRI on CDN resources; esc() for all user text in JS-generated HTML; server-side validation authoritative; secrets via config.local.js (gitignored) or Cloudflare env vars; Sec-Fetch-Site gating of /data/*.json and /src/* in _middleware.js.

nodes.label: Static-Site Hard Constraints
nodes.rationale: Vanilla JS ES modules only, no bundler/framework/SSR, no build step, zero runtime npm deps (Playwright dev-only); Cloudflare Pages free tier (100k invocations/day, 10ms CPU); code ships as-is and must run directly in the browser or the V8 Workers runtime.

nodes.label: Cloudflare Pages Functions
nodes.rationale: Server-side code lives only in functions/ on the V8 Workers runtime (no Node builtins); every response carries CORS via allowedOrigin(); inputs validated with length/size caps; errors return generic JSON without leaking internals; endpoints choose an explicit cache strategy (s-maxage+stale-while-revalidate for /api/places, no-store for /api/config).

nodes.label: Events Model
nodes.rationale: Events are not mosque-only: Location and Organizer are two independent optional links and must never be coupled. Location has three tiers (existing place, OSM/Digitransit pick, or custom Google Maps link resolved server-side via enrichPendingEventRows()); Organizer is free text optionally tied to a directory place_id. Rendering/filtering must never assume ev.placeId is set and must fall back to locationName/locationAddress/lat/lng.

nodes.label: Maps Link Enrichment (parseMapsUrl/resolveUrl)
nodes.rationale: Code.gs must handle every Google Maps share-link format. Mobile maps.app.goo.gl links resolve to ?q=...&ftid=0xHEX:0xHEX whose second hex segment is the place CID and must be BigInt hex->decimal converted (it exceeds Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER) into cid:<decimal>, else enrichment silently degrades to bare geocoding. resolveUrl()'s body-text fallback must decode \uXXXX escapes and not swallow the closing escaped quote; debug with testResolveMapsLink() before guessing.

nodes.label: Google Sheets as Database (Apps Script)
nodes.rationale: Per the agent definitions, data lives in a Google Sheet served through a Google Apps Script web app, proxied by /api/places and /api/submit; client JS never queries the Sheet directly. (Note: README states this Apps Script/Sheets backend is retired in favour of Cloudflare D1 — the agent docs are stale on this point.)
